title: How I Reduced RTO by 40% for a Pakistani Fashion Brand
excerpt:
To reduce RTO in Pakistan's COD market, you must fix operational workflows before dispatch. We reduced RTO by 40% by implementing strict checkout address verification, automated pre-delivery confirmation algorithms, and dynamic COD capping based on customer history, preventing fake orders from destroying reverse logistics margins.
